editorial:
Imagine a world where the glitz and glamour of the pop star life meet a weird, animated twist. You get thrown into a story that blends music, fame, and some really strange character designs that keep you guessing. It feels like a fever dream in the best way possible, mixing bright colors with a plot that doesn't always play by the rules. You will find yourself rooting for the main character as they navigate the pressures of being an idol while dealing with some truly bizarre situations that make the movie feel unique and fresh.

What really hits home is the pacing, which keeps things moving fast so you never get bored. The animation style is bold, though it might be a bit too weird for some people. If you love quirky stories and catchy beats, you should definitely give this one a shot.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head in a big final performance where the truth about the idol's identity is revealed. The main character finally accepts their true self instead of trying to fit the perfect image the world wants. After a chaotic climax, they find a way to balance their fame with their real personality. It wraps up on a happy note, showing that being yourself is more important than being a perfect star.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves anime and stories about the music industry.
